name: CodeBlock
label: Code block
description: Monospace code with a header and one-click copy.

props.name: code
props.description: The code to display, as a plain string

props.name: language
props.description: Language tag shown in the header, e.g. "tsx", "css"

props.name: filename
props.description: Filename shown in the header, e.g. "tokens-light.css"

props.name: onCopied
props.description: Called after the code is put on the clipboard, through the async API or its textarea fallback, so a host can count copies.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max height of the block; code scrolls vertically inside while the header stays pinned. Numbers are px.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Show a chevron beside the filename that collapses/expands the code area

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the copy button before it is pressed

props.name: copyText
props.description: Visible text on the copy button before it is pressed

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: Text and accessible name the copy button shows once the code is copied

props.name: expandLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the collapse toggle while the code is collapsed

props.name: collapseLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the collapse toggle while the code is showing

props.name: codeLabel
props.description:
Accessible name for the scrollable code region. Defaults to
"Code: <filename>", then "Code: <language>", then "Code".
